findings.title: Hardcoded API key in configuration
findings.description: An API key is hardcoded in the config file. This should be moved to environment variables.

verified.verificationNotes: No environment variable usage found for this key

findings.remediation: Move the API key to an environment variable and access via process.env.API_KEY

findings.title: N+1 query pattern in user listing
findings.description: The getUsersWithPosts function makes a separate database query for each user's posts.

verified.verificationNotes: No eager loading or join found

findings.remediation: Use Prisma's include option to load posts in a single query

positives: Consistent use of TypeScript with strict mode enabled
